name: Marie Antoinette
original_name: マリー・アントワネット
source:
"...Me, I just want to live freely. I really want to fly out of here and go into town to just do whatever I want."

Born in Austria.
Hobby: Dancing, Music, Riding Horses
Likes: Sweets
Dislikes: Reading

The French Crown Princess and later Queen.
A person who likes new things and experiences but hates rules and customs.
She's a bit of a selfish tomboy, but she is considerate towards her mother and her maid Liese.
